content: Ukoche na nnema
Kubulana na mpechangano pakate jhino ghahuma kojhe? Ibhoka mitama hino mboho ikomana nkate jhino?

Mmii na tama jha kupala ilebhe nambo mukipata jhe chela chimukipala kwa gheniya mwipala kukoma, mipala hake kupata ilebhe nambo mupata jhe yenio mikomana na kupechengana. Nhwalo mukipata jhe chimukipala nhwalo mangota minyopa jhe Chapanga.
Pumunnyopa Chapanga mipatajhe: Nhwalo nnyopa changanandela mujhopa kupala mitumile kwa tama jhino.

Mangotamwe ndi mabhando bhangahobholeka ngita akangongola. Bho, umanyite jhe kuipala ilebhe ya pannema kubhehe likoko lya Chapanga? Nhwalo mundo jhojhoha jwabhehe nkoche jwa pannema abhehe likoko lya Chapanga.
Mangahola jhe kubhehe Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghalonge malobhe gha jhajhe, pughalonge, “Uhuke jwabhekwitwe na Chapanga nkate jhito abhii na wiho nkolongwa.”
Nambo umbone gwatupii Chapanga ghuna makakala hake, ngita Majhandiko chighalonge, “Chapanga ubhakana bhando bhibhakikweya nambo bhapela bhando bhina uteeke na utembekelo.”
Bhahe, mu kitembekeye kwa Chapanga. Muntile Limbembela na jwenio nantilangana,
mu mandikile Chapanga na jwenio namandikila. Mangota bhummiii na uhakaho nnyelebhule mabhoko ghino na nnyelebhuhe miojho jhino mangota bhimmii na miojho mibhele!
Mma ngolongondi na kujhemba mihambo jha malelo nu kulela. Kuheka kwino kughalambuka na kubhehe mihambo jha malelo na kuhangana kwino kubhaha ungolongondi nkolongwa!
Mma na utembekelo palonge jha Bhambo na jwenio ndi nantondobheya.
Lupwato nhwalo gwa kunhadabuu nnyino

Nkoto kulonge ghanganandela kwa nnyino anda munongolii ghanganandela nnyino, peniya ndi mihadabula lilaghalikilo na anda milihadabula lilaghalikilo, peniya mwenga nabhijhokanikiya jhe nambo mihadabula lilaghalikilo.
Chapanga kanjika ndi jwahotwii kubheka malaghalikilo na kuhadabula. Jwenio kanjika ndi jwahoto kunkombola amu kukomelekela. Mihola mwe maghane ade nhoto kwahadabula majhii bhando?
Lupwato nhwalo gwa kuloka
Ngohe unyokanikiye mangota bhimilonge: “Deleno anda jhe kilabho nijhenda ku muche gwakiteno nu kutama kwenio kwa chaka choha kwa kuchulucha ilebhe nu kupata ulohe ngoo.”
Mangota mwe mmanyite jhe ughome gwino chiupala kubhehe kilabho! Ughome gwino kilebhe ghane, mangota mmii ngita ngongobhe ipitila na kwa kipinde kijhipe kuhobhalela.
Ngampalitwa kulonge: “Bhambo anda apahile natutama na kuhenga chenje na chela.”
Nambo ngohe mwitenda kuloka na kukikweya. Kuloka kwa namuna jhene kwamaha jhe.
Bhahe, mundo ihengajhe lela lyalimanye lilibhii lyambone lyapalwa kuhenga, itenda uhakaho.
